title: Skilllet marketplace scratchlog
summary: Brainstorm for a lightweight in-console marketplace of tiny, composable LLM microfeatures ("skilllets") that teams can opt into per-route. Focus: fast discovery, cost caps, per-user opt-in and A/B. This is a rough PRD/parking lot for experiments rather than final design.
idea_rationale: Customers want modular small features (summaries, extractors, formatters, tone adapters) that are cheap to run and can be toggled per route or per-user. Rather than bloating the main model surface with many options, expose curated microfeatures as separately billable components with clear cost/quality tradeoffs. Helps PLG uptake: demoable feature tiles in Console, quick enable, measurable unit economics.
user_stories: As a product engineer, I want to add a 'brief summary' skilllet to our 'document-chat' route so that users get condensed answers without changing our main prompt, and I can cap how much extra budget that skilllet can consume per session.
As an analytics lead, I want to see per-skilllet cost and usage on the model dashboard so we can decide which skilllets to standardize into the core product.
As an end-user, I want the assistant to offer a toggle for 'include sources' powered by a lightweight citation skilllet so I can opt-in only when I need it.
As an SRE, I want a fail-open policy so skilllet failures degrade gracefully and do not blow up main inference latency.
As a growth PM, I want to run a canary that shows the skilllet tile to 10% of free-tier users to measure conversion and incremental revenue.
acceptance_criteria: Console: list-of-skilllets mockup with enable/disable toggle and per-skilllet brief description
SDK/API: new parameter 'skilllets' accepts list of skilllet ids + per-skilllet budget (tokens or cost cap)
Runtime: if skilllet is configured, call routed to compatible runtime (same model variant or cheaper proxy model). If skilllet times out, main response continues without it.
Observability: per-skilllet metrics emitted (invocations, success rate, avg extra tokens, added latency, cost estimate)
Billing: usage attribution per skilllet (distinct line items in usage export)
metrics: Adoption: percent of routes with >=1 skilllet enabled (weekly)
Cost delta: average tokens/cost per request attributable to skilllets
Latency tail: 95/99th latency impact when skilllets enabled
Failure impact: percent of sessions where skilllet failure occurred and how often fallback used
rollout_plan: Phase 0: internal alpha - CLI + simple SDK hook, 3 internal services flip on two sample skilllets (summary, citation)
Phase 1: closed beta with 3 customers, Console tile for enablement + per-skilllet budget controls
Phase 2: PLG trial - expose skilllet storefront to free-tier users with soft limits and explanatory microcopy
Phase 3: monetization - add per-skilllet billing line and promote high-performing skilllets in Catalog
quick_arch_sketch: Skilllet registry (metadata + compatibility matrix) + runtime adapters. Flow: client sends skilllet list -> routing layer checks compatibility -> if local-fast-adapter exists route to cheap proxy model or lambda -> else call hosted model as chained call. KV cache reuse if skilllet input overlaps with main prompt. Add tracing span 'skilllet.<id>' and fallback policy record.
experiments_and_hypotheses: H1: A visible skilllet tile increases feature opt-ins by 3x vs buried toggle
H2: Offloading a skilllet to a smaller model reduces incremental cost by ~60% with negligible quality loss for short summarization tasks
H3: Per-skilllet cost transparency reduces support inquiries about unexpected bills
open_questions: What is the canonical granularity of a skilllet (single prompt template vs full stateful microflow)?
How do we surface confidence/quality cues in the Console so customers pick the right skilllet for their SLAs?
Should skilllets be first-class in model catalog or a separate registry? Security review implications for third-party skilllets?
Billing model: per-invocation flat fee, per-token delta, or subscription pack?
Can we reuse existing fallback/rollout infra (A/B + canary) or need new gates?
next_steps: Sketch Console tiles (Maya) / Draft SDK params (Ravi) / Spike: implement summary skilllet runtime adapter and cheap-model fallback (2w). Add telemetry prototype to see token delta. Sync with legal on potential third-party skilllet marketplace guidelines.
notes: Rough notes: keep API minimal at first (skilllet id + opt budget). UX: microcopy must explain cost impact. Consider a 'zero-cost preview' that returns a sample output size estimate before enabling. Keep rollout conservative: default disabled for existing customers unless they opt-in. Tie into Optimize suggestions later - detect repeated patterns and propose a skilllet.
